same_command_links.scope: Every archived per-event job: retained/Keep prior and final canonical posterior queried at exactly the same original acquisition stamp and command. Bayesian Reset and moment projection may change the posterior; their magnitude is diagnostic, not an acceptance gate. Archives beyond physical end are not attributed to online motion.

limitations: No subscriber packet capture or GPU paint-completion record is available. Publication acknowledgement is process-side.
Point-query sidecars do not independently reconstruct a full joint covariance; complete-law identity is checked from numeric candidate SHA and separately from K-job full state.
A deferred artifact may correspond to an earlier accepted candidate while a newer control candidate is active. This is reported as lag, not hidden by an identity flag.
